summary: Corning filed an 8-K on September 11, 2026, disclosing an Equity Distribution Agreement with Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC for an at-the-market offering of up to $2.0 billion of common stock, par value $0.50 per share. Goldman Sachs serves as sales agent and may also purchase shares as principal under separate terms agreements. Corning pays a 1.0% commission on gross proceeds and will sell from time to time based on market conditions, using net proceeds for general corporate purposes. This is a routine shelf takedown facility, not a special situation; watch dilution pace, share overhang and pricing relative to trading liquidity.
